projectDescription: A fun emoji flipping game built with React and Vite
This is a React-based application that allows users to input their information and generate a CV/résumé.
A responsive calculator application built to match a provided design, supporting basic arithmetic operations and theme switching with persisted user preferences.
A typing speed test application that measures WPM, accuracy, and consistency across different modes and difficulty levels, with persistent personal best tracking.
An interactive age calculator that computes exact age in years, months, and days from a valid date input, with robust validation and animated result transitions.

A JavaScript implementation of the classic Battleship game built with Test Driven Development (TDD). The project emphasizes modular architecture, isolated game logic, and unit testing with Jest, featuring a computer opponent that makes random, legal moves.
A responsive mortgage calculator that computes monthly and total repayments based on user input, with full keyboard accessibility and real-time form validation.
A demo e-commerce shopping cart built with React and Vite, featuring cart state management and component testing with React Testing Library.
A multi-page space tourism website with tabbed navigation for destinations, crew, and technology pages. Built with accessible, responsive design across mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints.
A responsive weather app powered by the Open-Meteo API, featuring location search, current conditions, 7-day forecast, hourly breakdown, and Imperial/Metric unit toggling.
